Sandbox_Artemis_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch for the scenario. When off, the journal and commands are ignored.
Sandbox_Artemis_NoteChance_tooltip: Chance, for each military zombie killed, that it carries the Artemis notebook. If both this value and the guaranteed minimum are 0, the notebook never appears.
Sandbox_Artemis_NoteGuaranteeKills_toolt: The notebook appears at the latest on the Nth military zombie killed. 0 = no guarantee.
Sandbox_Artemis_NoteMinDay_tooltip: The notebook cannot appear before this game day (the day changes at 7 AM). 0 = from the start.
Sandbox_Artemis_NoteRespawnDays_tooltip: If the notebook was not read (lost, body gone), a new one can appear after this many days.
Sandbox_Artemis_DramaIntensity_tooltip: Sets how key moments are staged, notably how far the scream heard on the radio at the first signal carries (low: half, normal, high: one and a half). The noise also depends on the radio volume; with headphones there is none.
Sandbox_Artemis_ScreenEffects_tooltip: Fades to black and character thoughts during scenes.
Sandbox_Artemis_SiegeNightControl_toolti: If the Siege Night mod is active: suspends its automatic sieges and mini-hordes without changing its options, then restores them. An overdue siege is pushed back one cycle (no catch-up siege). A siege in progress is never interrupted; a siege started by hand during the suspension plays out normally.
Sandbox_Artemis_SiegeNightControl_option: Suspend during the investigation (acts I and II)
Suspend until the file, from the start
Sandbox_Artemis_DebugMode_tooltip: Shows the debug context menu (start, advance, reset). For testing only.
Sandbox_Artemis_RadioFrequency_tooltip: Frequency of the ARTEMIS channel, rounded to 0.2 MHz steps. Change it if another mod already uses 108.0 MHz (the game log reports a frequency already taken). Common FM radios go up to 108.0; above that, a walkie-talkie or ham radio is needed. Avoid 88.0 to 107.8: the emergency broadcast can land there at random. Applied the next time the game is loaded.
Sandbox_Artemis_ExtractionHoldMinutes_to: Helicopter route: in-game minutes between the sound of the rotor (5 AM) and the landing, during which you must hold the landing zone.
Sandbox_Artemis_SterilizationDays_toolti: After the file is read, the army sterilizes the zone after this many days: the helicopter and the checkpoint close, the bombing drives the hordes, only the river remains. No real fire. 0: disabled.
